character.summary: An artist's studio rendered as a calm product UI: warm off-white paper, near-black ink for text and every action, hairline borders, and a tight grotesk with negative tracking. Color is withheld from the interface itself; the only chroma is an ink-blue watercolor wash that bleeds in from the page edge, with masking tape, pencil notes and one serif italic word acting as studio marks at the margins. The working area stays strictly quiet and monochrome so whatever content sits on it carries the color.

color.notes: Light only on the reference (styles.json supportsDark: false, every page darkDiffers: false); the template adds a DERIVED 'night paper' dark mode. No brand or accent color: the primary action, selected chip, focus ring and active tab underline are all ink #0e0e0c (crops p1-light-button-1/2, p1-light-button-focus, p3-light-tab-1). The only chromatic family is ink-blue/indigo, used decoratively (bloom, swash) and once functionally (info callout bar, pages.css .callout). Neutrals are warm (R>G>B by 3-6 units), never cool gray. Excluded as noise: Inter text, rgb(24,24,27), rgb(31,85,224), rgb(26,69,184), rgb(47,107,255), rgb(29,95,191), rgb(22,122,62), rgb(138,83,0), rgb(85,85,94), rgb(196,196,202), rgb(222,222,226), rgb(247,247,248) (4.18%, the fixture's screenshot background via --shot-bg) and inset 3px rgb(24,73,242) is our own callout. rgb(196,43,43) equals --err coincidentally and is kept because --err is ours. Off-token raw values found: #2a2a27 (primary hover, code-panel divider), #eeece6 (tool and package dividers), #9a9892 (code tab text, 2.74:1 - decorative only), #7be3ae (screenshot-label dot). Template folds #eeece6 into border.default.

spacing.notes: styles.json spacing top values 8 (13.8%), 10 (13.5%), 12 (11.9%), 16, 2, 14, 24, 3, 20, 6. Base 4px with 2px half-steps inside controls (10, 14 are real and frequent; keep them). Odd values 3, 5, 7, 9, 13, 15, 18, 22 are component-internal (segmented padding 3px, step-label offsets) and are rounded: 3->2 or 4 by context except the 3px segmented track padding which is kept as a component constant, 18->20, 22->24, 13->12/14. Section rhythm: 56-64 between blocks, 96 between detail sections (pages.css .detail-main gap), 120-128 between home sections and before the footer (rounded to 120); mobile halves these to 36/56/72. Gutter 40px desktop, 16px under 860px (--gutter).

shape.notes: styles.json radius: 7 (18.7%), 9 (17.0%), 14 (16.3%), 999 (13.8%), 8 (10.0%), 10 (9.0%), 18 (5.5%). Named variables --r-seg 7, --r-ctl 10, --r-shot 14, --r-panel 18. 8px (shot 'Details' button, menu items) is a stray between 7 and 9; template folds 8->7 for inner items and 9/10 into control 10 with 9 kept for the 40px button (both measured). Nesting rule visible in source: inner radius = outer minus padding (well 9/10 with 3px padding -> segment 7). borderWidth 1px everywhere (79.5%); 2px only as focus outline, selected-thumbnail ring and active-tab underline (drawn as box-shadow). Hairlines are often drawn as inset box-shadow rather than border (--shadow-rest).

elevation.role: rest (panel, card): hairline only, no drop

motion.notes: MEASURED: none. styles.json transition is empty; the only motion rule is @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) which disables all transitions and animations (globals.css). State changes are instant color swaps (.btn:hover border-color, .btn--primary:hover background). DERIVED for the template: 120ms color/border/background changes, 180ms for overlays (dialog, menu sheet, toast) fading plus 4px translate, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); no scale, bounce or parallax; studio details (bloom, tape, notes) never animate. 0ms under reduced motion.

layout.grid: Fluid 12-column content inside a 1360px max container with 40px gutters (16px under 860px). Gallery grid auto-fill minmax(520px,1fr), gap 56px rows / 32px columns. Detail page: main flex 640px basis + aside 360px, gap 56. Docs: 220px sidebar + article max 720px + 200px TOC, gap 56; sidebar and TOC hidden under 860px. Header 72px (60px mobile) with a hairline bottom border; footer hairline top border.
layout.notes: Single breakpoint at 860px (styles.json mediaQueries). Controls are compact (40px button, 36px chip, 32px segment) while section spacing is generous (96-120px), so overall density reads regular. Article measure capped at 720px. Mobile: filter chips scroll horizontally, card actions become a 2-column grid of 44px buttons, a sticky bottom action bar (52px buttons, 12px radius) appears on the detail page, pencil notes are hidden. Template derives a 4-column/16px mobile, 8-column/24px tablet (860-1199) grid and keeps 12/32px on desktop.

imagery.iconography: Almost icon-free: text glyph arrows (an up-right arrow on 'Details', left/right arrows on docs pagination), a two-line hamburger, a 6px status dot. DERIVED for the template: 1.5px stroke outline icons at 16/20px, round caps and joins, ink-3 by default and ink when active, never filled, never colored; an ISC/MIT set such as Lucide fits. Icons always paired with a text label on actions.
imagery.illustration: No illustration beyond the studio details: a watercolor bloom generated by an SVG filter (fractal-noise displacement, pigment rim, paper grain), masking tape strips, hand-written pencil notes with drawn arrows, and one brush swash. Media placeholders use a 135deg hairline hatch on the tray color. These are procedural and our own; the template re-specifies them as rules, not as copied SVG.
imagery.photography: None on the site. DERIVED: products that need photos (store, blog) place them in 14px-radius media frames with the hatch placeholder while loading; no filters, duotones or tints; bloom and tape never overlap a photo's subject.

doNot: Introduce a brand or accent hue for buttons, links, selected states or focus - action is ink (light) / paper (dark), always
Use cool or pure grays (#f5f5f5, #e5e7eb, slate) - every neutral is warm
Put the bloom, tape, pencil notes or swash inside data areas: tables, forms, charts, dialogs, toasts, menus, code blocks or product photos
Use more than one bloom per screen, tape on non-pinned items, or more than two pencil notes per screen
Set more than one serif italic word per page title, or use the serif for body, buttons, labels or navigation
Use font weight 700 or heavier; the ladder is 400/500/600
Give every card a drop shadow - rest elevation is a 1px hairline; the long pinned shadow is reserved for one or two lifted objects
Use the ink-blue anywhere functional except the info status (callout bar, info badge, info toast)
Signal status by hue alone - every status pairs color with an icon or a text label
Let bloom sit behind body or secondary text; only display headings may overlap it (p5-mobile-light.png shows the subtitle over the wash - avoid)
Animate studio details or add bouncy/scale motion
Round corners beyond the set (5/7/9-10/12/14/18/20/pill) or mix square and pill controls in one group
ipRisks: The reference is our own platform site; there is no third-party IP risk. Nothing else is restricted beyond the items below.

Brand term 'Pigment' (intake.json brandTerms) must not appear in the template id, name, description, prose, tokens or examples - including the 'Pigment' wordmark and @pigment/mcp, mcp.pigment.dev strings.
The blot logomark next to the wordmark (p1-desktop-light.png header) is the platform's mark and is not carried over; the template has no logo.

Platform copy is not carried over: headlines ('Give your agent a palette, not a prompt.', 'Mix once. Paint forever.', 'Connect an agent once.', 'Compare, side by side.'), the sign-off 'No happy accidents.', and the pencil-note texts.
Fonts are all SIL OFL 1.1 (Geist, Geist Mono, Instrument Serif, Caveat) and may be kept as-is; no proprietary font is involved.
Fixture-system content on /s/fixture-system (Inter samples, blue #1f55e0 family, its swatches) is not our design and is excluded entirely.
